verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Omarchy ships OpenCode and Claude Code as the default agent harnesses for programmers. On first boot it invites the user to set up a default agent, and it bundles agent skills for building apps, plugins and themes. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that these agents run in the terminal to write and execute code (this is only implied by the harnesses named), and independent or hands-on community corroboration of the agent workflow.
